scripts.deploy:comment: Workers Builds deploys on every push to main, so this is only for a deploy by hand, with your own `wrangler login`. Run it with `pnpm --filter slab-site run deploy`, since a bare `deploy` is pnpm's own command.
scripts.og: astro build && pnpm og:generate && astro build
scripts.og:check:comment: Fails when a page has no link preview card, or its card was drawn from text the page no longer has. Run by the root `pnpm lint`, so CI's Lint job catches it.
scripts.og:comment: The cards are read from the built pages, so the site's built first, then again so they're copied into it. Only missing and out-of-date cards are drawn. To redraw them all after changing the card's design, build the site and run `pnpm --filter slab-site og:generate --all`.
scripts.rpg:sprites:comment: Draws the Retro RPG showcase's pixel sprites into `public/rpg` from the drawings in `rpg/art.js`. Run it when a drawing changes.
